# Setup
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(Seurat)
library(infercnv)
library(pals)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(rstatix)
library(liana)


root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))


results.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/")
processed.data.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/")

sample.id <- "all_postmortem_samples" 

if (sample.id == "all_postmortem_samples") {
  sample.info.df <- read_excel(paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "autopsy_sample_information.xlsx"), sheet = 1) %>% filter(`Patient` %in% c("P1", "P2", "P4"))
  cluster.info.df <- read_excel(paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "autopsy_sample_information.xlsx"), sheet = 2) %>% filter(`Patient` == "all_postmortem_samples")
} else {
  sample.info.df <- read_excel(paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "autopsy_sample_information.xlsx"), sheet = 1) %>% filter(`Patient` == sample.id)
  cluster.info.df <- read_excel(paste0(root.dir, "RawData/", "autopsy_sample_information.xlsx"), sheet = 2) %>% filter(`Patient` == sample.id)
}

set.seed(123)
```



# Settings 
```{r}
cd45.neg.ref.use  <- "velmeshev2019"
start.from.scratch <- F

denoise           <- F
denoise.vars.to.regress <- c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")


filter            <- F
if (denoise && filter) {
  filter.low.qc   <- T # if TRUE filter the same as not denoising
}

cellbender        <- F
batch.correction  <- "None"

if (denoise) {
  denoise.label <- paste0(denoise.vars.to.regress, collapse = "_")
} else {
  denoise.label <- "FALSE"
}

if (filter) {
  if (denoise && filter.low.qc) {
    filter.label <- "TRUE.low.qc"
  } else {
    filter.label <- "TRUE"
  } 
} else {
  filter.label <- "FALSE"
}


# make output directories
output.dir <- paste0(sample.id, "_cellbender.", cellbender, "_denoise.", denoise.label, "_filter.", filter, "_batch.correction.", batch.correction, "/")
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "umap/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "pca/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "markers/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "malignant/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "malignant/", "neftel/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "malignant/", "tirosh/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "oligodendrocytes/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "interactions/"))

cd45.neg.refs <- c("velmeshev2019", "herring2022")
for (ref in cd45.neg.refs) {
  dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/", ref, "/"))
  dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/", ref, "/", "celltype_composition/"))
  dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/", ref, "/", "celltypes_by_cluster/"))
  dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/", ref, "/", "filtered_out_by_celltype/"))
  dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "celltype_prediction/", ref, "/", "prediction_scores/"))
}
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "by_sample_id/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "metaprograms/"))
dir.create(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "inferCNV/"))

dir.create(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir))
dir.create(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, "seurat_objects/"))
dir.create(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, "seurat_objects/", "scalopOutput/"))
```





# Standard Seurat pipeline on data
```{r}
# use saved object before filter if exists
output.dir.save <- paste0(sample.id, "_cellbender.", cellbender, "_denoise.", "FALSE", "_filter.", filter, "_batch.correction.", batch.correction, "/")
seurat.obj.save <- paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir.save, "seurat_objects/", sample.id, "_save.RDS")


set.seed(123)
if (!start.from.scratch && file.exists(seurat.obj.save)) {
  print(paste0("Reading in seurat object from ", seurat.obj.save))
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(seurat.obj.save)  
} else {
  # read in data for each sample and merge
  seurat.obj.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(sample.info.df)) {
    sample.df <- sample.info.df[i, ]
    full.sample.id <- sample.df$`Sample ID`
    
    print("=====")
    print(full.sample.id)
    
    if (cellbender) {
      counts.data <- Read10X_h5(paste0(root.dir, sample.df$`Cell Ranger output path`, "post_cellbender_feature_bc_matrix_filtered_seurat.h5"), use.names = TRUE)
    } else {
      counts.data <- Read10X_h5(paste0(root.dir, sample.df$`Cell Ranger output path`, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))
    }
    
    # downsample to save space
    if (ncol(counts.data) > 10000) {
      counts.data <- counts.data[, sample(ncol(counts.data), 10000)]
    }
    
    seurat.obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts.data)
    print(paste('count matrix # of genes:', dim(seurat.obj)[1]))
    print(paste('count matrix # of cells:', dim(seurat.obj)[2]))
    
    patient.id <- sample.df$`Patient`
    seurat.obj$patient <- patient.id
    patient.desc <- case_when(
      patient.id == "P1" ~ "GBM 1",
      patient.id == "P2" ~ "GBM 2",
      patient.id == "P4" ~ "IDH-mut 1",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
    
    seurat.obj$patient.desc <- patient.desc
    seurat.obj$section <- sample.df$Section
    seurat.obj$patient.section <- paste(seurat.obj$patient, seurat.obj$section)
    seurat.obj$sample.id <- full.sample.id
    seurat.obj$method <- sample.df$Method
    seurat.obj$location <- sample.df$`Location`
    seurat.obj$sample.desc <- paste(seurat.obj$patient.desc, seurat.obj$location)
    seurat.obj$sample.desc.method <- paste(seurat.obj$sample.desc, seurat.obj$method)
    
    print("unique(seurat.obj$sample.desc)")
    print(unique(seurat.obj$sample.desc))
    
    # add percent.mt
    seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-") 
    seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- sapply(seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x)) # set percent.mt NA to zero for now (for cellbender)
    
    
    seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
    seurat.obj.list[[full.sample.id]] <- seurat.obj
  }
  
  
  if (length(seurat.obj.list) > 1) {
    seurat.obj <- merge(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)], add.cell.ids=names(seurat.obj.list), merge.data=T)
    seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat.obj[["RNA"]])
  }
  
  seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
  
  print("Number of cells unfiltered")
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  
  # QC plot
  assay.use <- "RNA"
  p1 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low, color='red') + geom_hline(yintercept = nFeature_RNA.cutoff.high, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("nCount_RNA"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = nCount_RNA.cutoff.low, color='red') +  geom_hline(yintercept = nCount_RNA.cutoff.high, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p3 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("percent.mt"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = percent.mt.cutoff, color='red') + geom_hline(yintercept = percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p4 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.signature"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = post.mortem.noise.cutoff, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p5 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.sensitive"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  p6 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.glial"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  p7 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("heat.shock.signature"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  
  p <- p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_QC.before.filter.pdf"), width=8, height=32)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  # remove very low quality cells
  seurat.obj$filter.out <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.filter.out) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out))
  
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (filter.out == FALSE))
  print("After removing very low quality cells:")
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  
  
  # QC plot after filter
  p1 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low, color='red') + geom_hline(yintercept = nFeature_RNA.cutoff.high, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p2 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("nCount_RNA"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = nCount_RNA.cutoff.low, color='red') +  geom_hline(yintercept = nCount_RNA.cutoff.high, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p3 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("percent.mt"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = percent.mt.cutoff, color='red') + geom_hline(yintercept = percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p4 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.signature"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + geom_hline(yintercept = post.mortem.noise.cutoff, color='red') + NoLegend()
  p5 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.sensitive"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  p6 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("postmortem.glial"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  p7 <- VlnPlot(seurat.obj, pt.size=0, features = c("heat.shock.signature"), ncol = 1, group.by = "sample.id", assay = assay.use) + NoLegend()
  
  p <- p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_QC.after.filter.pdf"), width=8, height=32)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  # define low-quality cells
  seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))
  
  seurat.obj$high.postmortem.noise <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[["postmortem.signature"]]) > post.mortem.noise.cutoff))
  
  table(seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc) 
  table(seurat.obj$high.postmortem.noise) 
  
  
  # filter out low-quality/high-postmortem-noise cells
  if (filter) {
    if (denoise) {
      if (filter.low.qc) {
        seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))
      } else {
        seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (high.postmortem.noise == FALSE))
      }
    } else {
      seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (low.quality.by.qc == FALSE))
    }
  }
  
  
  # remove doublets
  use.doublet.finder <- T
  if (use.doublet.finder) {
    print("Using doublet finder")
    n.dims.use <- 30
    seurat.obj.list <- list()
    for (sample.id.i in sort(unique(seurat.obj$sample.id))) {
      print(sample.id.i)
      sample.dir <- paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/", sample.id.i, "/")
      dir.create(sample.dir)
      seurat.obj.sample <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.id == sample.id.i)
      print(dim(seurat.obj.sample))
      
      # just use doublet finder for samples with > 25k nuclei
      if (sample.id.i %in% c("P2 S16 10X", "P2 S16 Invent")) {
        print("Using doublet finder")
        seurat.obj.sample <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj.sample)
        seurat.obj.sample <- find.doublets(seurat.obj.sample, pcs.use.doublet.finder=1:n.dims.use, qc.output.dir = sample.dir)
        seurat.obj.sample <- subset(seurat.obj.sample, subset = (doubFind_res == "Singlet"))
      } else {
        seurat.obj.sample$potential.doublet <- apply(seurat.obj.sample@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) > nCount_RNA.cutoff.high) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) > nFeature_RNA.cutoff.high))
        seurat.obj.sample <- subset(seurat.obj.sample, subset = (potential.doublet == FALSE))
      }
      
      
      seurat.obj.list[[sample.id.i]] <- seurat.obj.sample
    }
    seurat.obj <- merge(seurat.obj.list[[1]], seurat.obj.list[2:length(seurat.obj.list)])
    seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat.obj[["RNA"]])
    
  } else {
    print("Not using doublet finder")
    seurat.obj$potential.doublet <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) > nCount_RNA.cutoff.high) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) > nFeature_RNA.cutoff.high))
    seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (potential.doublet == FALSE))
  }
  
  
  print("After doublet removal:")
  print(dim(seurat.obj))
  
  
  # cell cycle scoring
  s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
  g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
  seurat.obj <- CellCycleScoring(seurat.obj, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, search = T)
  
  
  
  saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, "seurat_objects/", sample.id, "_save.RDS"))
}


print("Starting Seurat pipeline")
seurat.obj$tumor.adjacent <- sapply(seurat.obj$sample.id, function(x) x %ni% healthy.sections)


# add postmortem signatures and other signatures
seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures)


DefaultAssay(seurat.obj) <- "RNA"
seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj)


if (denoise) {
  seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
} else {
  seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)
}

set.seed(123)
seurat.obj <- RunPCA(seurat.obj, approx=T, seed.use=42)
p <- ElbowPlot(seurat.obj, ndims=50)
pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_elbowplot.pdf"), height=6, width=8)
print(p)
dev.off()



num.dims <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Number of dimensions for clustering`)
clustering.res <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Resolution for clustering`)


seurat.obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj, dims = 1:num.dims, nn.method = "rann")
random.seed.use <- 0
seurat.obj <- FindClusters(seurat.obj, resolution = clustering.res, random.seed = random.seed.use)


seurat.obj$seurat_clusters <- as.character(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters)
seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims = 1:num.dims, n.neighbors=30, min.dist = 0.1, seed.use=42)

seurat.obj$sample.id <- factor(seurat.obj$sample.id, levels = sample.ids)
seurat.obj$patient.section <- factor(seurat.obj$patient.section, levels = patient.sections)
seurat.obj$sample.desc <- factor(seurat.obj$sample.desc, levels = sample.descs)


# UMAP
if (dim(seurat.obj)[2] > 50000) {
  do.raster <- T
} else {
  do.raster <- F
}


celltype.features <- c("PTPRC", "ITGAM", "CD247", "CD3E", "RBFOX3", "GAD1", "SLC17A7", "GFAP", "AQP4", "ALDH1L1", "OLIG2", "SOX10", "PDGFRA", "CSPG4", "MBP", "MOG", "ASPA", "ACTA2", "CLDN5", "CDK4", "MDM2", "EGFR", "MKI67")

p.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label=T, shuffle=T, raster=F) + ggtitle("Cluster")
p.patient <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "patient", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Donor")
p.sample <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "sample.id", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Sample ID") + sample.ids.color.scale
p.patient.section <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "patient.section", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Patient + section") + patient.sections.color.scale
p.sample.desc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "sample.desc", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=F) + ggtitle("Sample description") + sample.descs.color.scale
p.method <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "method", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Method")
p.tumor.adj <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "tumor.adjacent", label=F, shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Tumor-adjacent") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))

p.phase <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "Phase", shuffle=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Predicted Cell Cycle Phase")
p.low.quality.qc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "low.quality.by.qc", order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Low-quality") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))
#p.doublet <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "potential.doublet", order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Doublet") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))
p.high.postmortem.noise <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "high.postmortem.noise", order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("High postmortem noise") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))

p.percent.mt <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("percent.mt"), order=T, raster=do.raster) 
p.ncount.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("nCount_RNA"), order=T, raster=do.raster) 
p.nfeature.rna <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), order=T, raster=do.raster)
p.postmortem.noise <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("postmortem.signature"), order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Postmortem noise")
p.heat.shock <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("heat.shock.signature"), order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Heat shock")

p.postmortem.glial <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("postmortem.glial"), order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Postmortem glial")
p.oligo.like <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("oligo.like"), order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Tumor-adjacent oligodendrocyte signature")

p <- p.clusters + p.patient + p.sample + p.patient.section + p.sample.desc + p.method + p.tumor.adj +
  p.phase + p.low.quality.qc + p.high.postmortem.noise +
  p.percent.mt + p.ncount.rna + p.nfeature.rna + p.postmortem.noise + p.heat.shock + p.postmortem.sensitive + p.postmortem.glial + p.oligo.like
 
for (g in celltype.features) {
  p <- p + FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c(g), order=T, raster=do.raster)
}

saveRDS(seurat.obj, paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, "seurat_objects/", sample.id, ".RDS"))
```

# Find cluster markers
```{r}
Idents(seurat.obj) <- 'seurat_clusters'

seurat.obj.downsample <- seurat.obj
seurat.obj.downsample$downsample <- TRUE
seurat.obj.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.downsample, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = 1000)

markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.obj.downsample, only.pos = TRUE, slot = "data", logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.1) # takes too long if using regressed out data

write.table(markers, paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "markers/", sample.id, "_markers.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=T)

markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 0.25, pct.1 > 0.1, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    ungroup() -> top10
seurat.obj.downsample <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.downsample, features = top10$gene)
p <- DoHeatmap(seurat.obj.downsample, features = top10$gene, raster = F) + NoLegend()
pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, 'markers/', sample.id, '_heatmap.pdf'), width=24, height=18)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Cell types by cluster
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, "seurat_objects/", sample.id, ".RDS"))

all.clusters <- unique(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters)
cd45.pos.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`CD45+ Clusters`) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
malignant.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Malignant Clusters`) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()


astro.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Astrocytes) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
oligo.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Oligodendrocytes) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
opc.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(OPC) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
exc.neuron.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Excitatory neurons`) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
inh.neuron.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Inhibitory neurons`) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
myeloid.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Myeloid) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
lymphoid.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Lymphoid) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
endothelial.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Endothelial) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
mural.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Mural) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()
vascular.clusters <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(Vascular) %>% str_split(", ") %>% unlist()

seurat.obj$celltype.by.cluster <- sapply(seurat.obj$seurat_clusters, function(x) case_when(
  x %in% astro.clusters ~ "Astrocytes",
  x %in% oligo.clusters ~ "Oligodendrocytes",
  x %in% opc.clusters ~ "OPC",
  x %in% exc.neuron.clusters ~ "Excitatory neurons",
  x %in% inh.neuron.clusters ~ "Inhibitory neurons",
  x %in% myeloid.clusters ~ "Myeloid",
  x %in% lymphoid.clusters ~ "Lymphoid",
  x %in% endothelial.clusters ~ "Endothelial",
  x %in% mural.clusters ~ "Mural",
  x %in% vascular.clusters ~ "Vascular",
  x %in% malignant.clusters ~ "Malignant cluster",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
))

DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = T) 
DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "celltype.by.cluster") + cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale
```



# Cell type projection Velmeshev 2019
```{r}

# load reference
if (denoise) {
  reference <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, 'ExternalData/', 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'after.clean', '.velmeshev2019.autism.control.only.seurat.obj.RDS'))
} else {
  reference <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, 'ExternalData/', 'Velmeshev_2019_Autism/', 'SeuratObjects/', 'before.clean', '.velmeshev2019.autism.control.only.seurat.obj.RDS'))
}


# use all cells. CD45+ and malignant cells are overlaid
seurat.obj.subset <- seurat.obj#subset(seurat.obj, subset = seurat_clusters %in% setdiff(all.clusters, c(malignant.clusters, cd45.pos.clusters)))
print(paste('cd45- cells:', dim(seurat.obj.subset)[2]))

# project all cells
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = reference,
  query = seurat.obj.subset,
  reduction = 'pcaproject',
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:20
)

seurat.obj.subset <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  query = seurat.obj.subset,
  reference = reference,
  refdata = list(
    annotation_l1 = "annotation_l1",
    annotation_l2 = "annotation_l2",
    annotation_l3 = "annotation_l3"
  ),
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction.model = "umap"
)

DimPlot(seurat.obj.subset, group.by = "predicted.annotation_l1")
DimPlot(seurat.obj.subset, group.by = "predicted.annotation_l2")
DimPlot(reference, group.by = "annotation_l2", reduction = "pca")

write.table(seurat.obj.subset@meta.data, paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '_w_celltypes.non.malignant.cd45.neg.velmeshev2019.tsv'), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T)
```

# Malignant subtypes
```{r }
seurat.obj.malignant <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (seurat_clusters %in% malignant.clusters)) #  & (sample.id %ni% healthy.sections)
seurat.obj.malignant$seurat_clusters.original <- seurat.obj.malignant$seurat_clusters


seurat.obj.gbm <- subset(seurat.obj.malignant, subset = patient %in% c("P1", "P2"))
seurat.obj.idh <- subset(seurat.obj.malignant, subset = patient %in% c("P4"))


# malignant state scoring 
seurat.obj.idh <- score.idh.mutant.state(seurat.obj.idh)
seurat.obj.idh$idh.mutant.state <- paste0(seurat.obj.idh$idh.mutant.state, " (Tirosh)")
seurat.obj.idh$malignant.state <- seurat.obj.idh$idh.mutant.state
seurat.obj.gbm <- score.neftel(seurat.obj.gbm)
seurat.obj.gbm$neftel_type <- paste0(seurat.obj.gbm$neftel_type, " (Neftel)")
seurat.obj.gbm$malignant.state <- seurat.obj.gbm$neftel_type

seurat.obj.malignant <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.malignant, seurat.obj.idh@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(`stem-like1`, `AC-like IDH-A2`, `OC-like IDH-A3`, `AC-like IDH-O4`, `OC-like IDH-O5`, ac.score, oc.score, stemness.score, lineage.score, lineage.score.plot, idh.mutant.state, malignant.state))
seurat.obj.malignant <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj.malignant, seurat.obj.gbm@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(ac_sig.21, mes1_sig.22, mes2_sig.23, npc1_sig.24, npc2_sig.25, opc_sig.26, ac_sig, opc_sig, mes_sig, npc_sig, stemness, neftel_x, neftel_y, neftel_type, malignant.state))


quality.metric <- "Low quality"
seurat.obj.gbm$neftel_type_w_quality <- apply(seurat.obj.gbm@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[['low.quality.by.qc']], quality.metric, row[["neftel_type"]]))
seurat.obj.idh$idh.mutant.state_w_quality <- apply(seurat.obj.idh@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[['low.quality.by.qc']], quality.metric, row[["idh.mutant.state"]]))


# neftel plot with additional quality annotation
if (!filter) {
  p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.gbm@meta.data, aes(neftel_x, neftel_y, color=neftel_type_w_quality)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
    xlab("Relative meta-module score") +
    ylab("Relative meta-module score") +
    facet_wrap(~sample.id) +
    xlim(-1.6, 1.6) +
    ylim(-1.6, 1.6) +
    labs(color = "Malignant subtype") +
    malignant.state.color.scale
    
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, 'malignant/', 'neftel/', sample.id, '.neftel.plot.w.quality.pdf'), width = 18, height = 10)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.idh@meta.data, aes(lineage.score.plot, stemness.score, color=idh.mutant.state)) + 
    geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
    xlab("Relative meta-module score") +
    ylab("Relative meta-module score") +
    facet_wrap(~sample.id) +
    xlim(-2, 2) +
    ylim(-2, 2) +
    labs(color = "Malignant subtype") +
    malignant.state.color.scale 
  
  pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, 'malignant/', 'tirosh/', sample.id, '.tirosh.plot.w.quality.pdf'), width = 7, height = 7)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}

# standard seurat pipeline
seurat.obj.malignant <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj.malignant)
seurat.obj.malignant <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj.malignant)

if (denoise) {
  seurat.obj.malignant <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.malignant, vars.to.regress = denoise.vars.to.regress)
} else {
  seurat.obj.malignant <- ScaleData(seurat.obj.malignant)
}

set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.malignant <- RunPCA(seurat.obj.malignant, seed.use=42, approx=T)

p <- ElbowPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, ndims=50)
pdf(paste0(results.dir, output.dir, "qc/", sample.id, "_elbowplot.malignant.pdf"), height=6, width=8)
print(p)
dev.off()


num.dims.malignant <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Number of dimensions for clustering malignant`)
clustering.res.malignant <- cluster.info.df %>% filter(CellBender == cellbender, Denoise == denoise.label, Filter == filter) %>% pull(`Resolution for clustering malignant`)

seurat.obj.malignant <- FindNeighbors(seurat.obj.malignant, dims=1:num.dims.malignant, nn.method = "rann")
seurat.obj.malignant <- FindClusters(seurat.obj.malignant, resolution = clustering.res.malignant, cluster.name = "malignant_clusters", random.seed = 0)
seurat.obj.malignant$malignant_clusters <- as.character(seurat.obj.malignant$malignant_clusters)
seurat.obj.malignant <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj.malignant, dims=1:num.dims.malignant, seed.use=42)


# plot UMAP of malignant cells
p.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'malignant_clusters', shuffle=T, label=T)
p.seurat.clusters <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'seurat_clusters.original', shuffle=T, label=T)
p.patient <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'patient', shuffle=T)
p.sample.id <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'sample.id', shuffle=T) + sample.ids.color.scale
p.patient.section <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'patient.section', shuffle=T) + patient.sections.color.scale
p.sample.desc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'sample.desc', shuffle=T) + sample.descs.color.scale
p1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'neftel_type', shuffle=T) + malignant.state.color.scale
p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'idh.mutant.state', shuffle=T) + malignant.state.color.scale
p3 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = 'Phase', shuffle=T)
p4 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = "low.quality.by.qc", shuffle=T, order=T) + ggtitle("Low-quality") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))
p5 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj.malignant, group.by = "high.postmortem.noise", shuffle=T, order=T) + ggtitle("High postmortem noise") + scale_color_manual(breaks=c(FALSE, TRUE), values=c("grey", "red"))
p6 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'percent.mt', order=T)
p7 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'nCount_RNA', order=T)
p8 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'nFeature_RNA', order=T)
p9 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'postmortem.signature', order=T)
p10 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'postmortem.sensitive', order=T)
p11 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'heat.shock.signature', order=T)
p12 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'ac_sig', order=T)
p13 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'mes_sig', order=T)
p14 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'npc_sig', order=T)
p15 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'opc_sig', order=T)
p16 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'stemness', order=T)
p17 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'ac.score', order=T)
p18 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'oc.score', order=T)
p19 <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj.malignant, features = 'stemness.score', order=T)


p <- p.clusters + p.seurat.clusters + p.patient + p.sample.id + p.patient.section + p.sample.desc +
  p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7 + p8 + p9 + p10 + p11 + p12 + p13 + p14 + p15 + p16 + p17 + p18 + p19
```

```{r}
## read in saved seurat object

# add neftel predictions to seurat object
seurat.obj.malignant.metadata <- read.csv(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '.malignant.tsv'), sep = "\t")
malignant.metadata.df <- seurat.obj.malignant.metadata %>% 
  dplyr::select(ac_sig.21, mes1_sig.22, mes2_sig.23, npc1_sig.24, npc2_sig.25, 
                opc_sig.26, ac_sig, opc_sig, mes_sig, npc_sig, stemness,
                neftel_x, neftel_y, neftel_type, 
                stem.like1, AC.like.IDH.A2, OC.like.IDH.A3, AC.like.IDH.O4, OC.like.IDH.O5, 
                ac.score, oc.score, stemness.score, lineage.score, lineage.score.plot, idh.mutant.state,
                malignant.state, malignant_clusters)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, malignant.metadata.df)


# add cell type predictions
seurat.obj.cd45.neg.metadata <- read.csv(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '_w_celltypes.non.malignant.cd45.neg.', cd45.neg.ref.use, '.tsv'), sep = "\t")
seurat.obj.cd45.neg.df <- seurat.obj.cd45.neg.metadata %>% 
  dplyr::select(predicted.annotation_l1, predicted.annotation_l1.score,
         predicted.annotation_l2, predicted.annotation_l2.score,
         predicted.annotation_l3, predicted.annotation_l3.score)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, seurat.obj.cd45.neg.metadata)

seurat.obj.cd45.pos.metadata <- read.csv(paste0(processed.data.dir, output.dir, 'seurat_objects/', sample.id, '_w_celltypes.non.malignant.cd45.pos.tsv'), sep = "\t")
seurat.obj.cd45.pos.df <- seurat.obj.cd45.pos.metadata %>% 
  dplyr::select(predicted.annotation_l1, predicted.annotation_l1.score,
         predicted.annotation_l2, predicted.annotation_l2.score,
         predicted.annotation_l3, predicted.annotation_l3.score)
colnames(seurat.obj.cd45.pos.metadata) <- paste0(colnames(seurat.obj.cd45.pos.metadata), "_cd45.pos")
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, seurat.obj.cd45.pos.metadata)


seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l1 <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row["malignant_clusters"]) ~ "Malignant cluster",
  !is.na(row["predicted.annotation_l1_cd45.pos"]) ~ row["predicted.annotation_l1_cd45.pos"],
  TRUE ~ row["predicted.annotation_l1"]
))
seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l2 <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row["malignant_clusters"]) ~ "Malignant cluster",
  !is.na(row["predicted.annotation_l2_cd45.pos"]) ~ row["predicted.annotation_l2_cd45.pos"],
  TRUE ~ row["predicted.annotation_l2"]
))
seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l3 <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row["malignant_clusters"]) ~ "Malignant cluster",
  !is.na(row["predicted.annotation_l3_cd45.pos"]) ~ row["predicted.annotation_l3_cd45.pos"],
  TRUE ~ row["predicted.annotation_l3"]
))
seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l2.w.neftel <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row["malignant_clusters"]) ~ row["malignant.state"],
  TRUE ~ row["predicted.annotation_l2"]
))



seurat.obj$seurat_clusters_fine <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row['malignant_clusters']) ~ paste0("M_", row['malignant_clusters']),
  !is.na(row['oligodendrocyte_clusters']) ~ paste0("O_", row['oligodendrocyte_clusters']),
  TRUE ~ row['seurat_clusters']
))
seurat.obj$seurat_clusters_fine_plot <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  !is.na(row['malignant_clusters']) ~ paste0("M_", row['malignant_clusters']),
  !is.na(row['oligodendrocyte_clusters']) ~ paste0("O_", row['oligodendrocyte_clusters']),

))



##### cell type prediction scores #####

seurat.obj$malignant.state.w.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(

))

# function to add the number of cells per cell type/group in the legend. Returns a color scale with counts that can be added to a DimPlot
get.count.labels <- function(metadata.col, mapping) {
  cell.counts <- table(metadata.col)
  cell.counts <- cell.counts[intersect(names(mapping), names(cell.counts))]
  
  labels.w.counts <- paste0(
    names(cell.counts),
    " (n=", as.integer(cell.counts), ")"
  )
  names(labels.w.counts) <- names(cell.counts)
  color.scale.w.counts <- scale_color_manual(
    labels = labels.w.counts,
    breaks = names(labels.w.counts),
    values = mapping[names(cell.counts)]
  )
  return(color.scale.w.counts)
}

p.oligo.like <- FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("oligo.like"), order=T, raster=do.raster) + ggtitle("Tumor-adjacent oligodendrocyte signature") + NoAxes()

p <- p.clusters + p.clusters.fine + p.celltype.by.cluster + p.celltype.l1 + p.celltype.l1.w.qc + p.celltype.l2 + p.celltype.l2.w.qc + p.celltype.l3 + p.neftel +
  p.patient + p.sample + p.patient.section + p.sample.desc + p.tumor.adj + p.method +

  p.percent.mt + p.ncount.rna + p.nfeature.rna + p.postmortem.noise + p.heat.shock + p.postmortem.sensitive + p.postmortem.glial + p.oligo.like
```
